entities.summary: Kiyotaka Kanai is a Japanese amateur astronomer, observer of variable stars, discoverer of comet C/1970 B1, and co-discoverer of the main-belt asteroid 7752 Otauchunokai, named after the Ota Uchuno Kai group, an amateur astronomers' club at Ōta city, of which he is a member of. Kiyotaka Kanai was a astronomers & cosmologists from Japan (b. 1951). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
